answer: The whisper schedule is applied in spiral and ledge exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 27% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3909 identities would post 2585 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
